fix(preserve-modules): keep non-JS extensions in [name] (#11410)

With `preserveModules`, `[name]` was built from the extension-stripped
module path, while `chunk.name` already kept non-JS extensions. So
`card.json` got emitted as `card.js` and the real `card.js` module was
pushed to `card2.js`.

`[name]` now uses the same string as `chunk.name`: query/hash is dropped
first, then only JS/TS extensions are removed, matching Rollup's
`getPreserveModulesChunkNameFromModule`. The repro now emits `index.js`,
`card.js` and `card.json.js`, and `note.ts` still becomes `note.js`.

Added a fixture for #11400 and updated the existing preserve-modules
snapshots that had the JSON extension stripped (10020, 7146,
json_namespace_preserves_exports, issue-10186).

Fixes #11400
